name: Media Marquee
description: Everything that plays, in one arcade-style display. Plex video shows its Fanart.tv banner alternating with an info card; other apps and music show the player's art or the LaMetric service icon with title, time remaining and a segmented progress bar. Idle: rotating banners (curated in the portal, else recently added on Plex). Web portal: live panel view, banner picker, icon and GIF upload. Replaces plex-marquee + now-playing.
author: ant456

versions.notes: Arcade redesign in the NBA/NFL Live style: shared 3x5 pixel font and drawing kit, header band + gradient title row on the info card, NOW PLAYING burst when new content starts, hazard-stripe INSERT COIN idle screen.
Web portal: live view, banner picker + rotation editor, icon/GIF upload. Uploaded GIFs render full screen. Display path never blocks on the network.
First combined release of plex-marquee and now-playing
